title: WhatsApp Status Saver
summary: Save WhatsApp status photos & videos instantly. Download, share & keep forever.
description:
WhatsApp Status Saver – Fast & Easy Status Downloader

Want to save WhatsApp status photos and videos before they disappear in 24 hours?
This WhatsApp Status Saver app helps you download and keep statuses permanently, so you can view, share, and repost them anytime.

With one-tap saving, built-in media viewer, and offline access, it makes status saving simple, fast, and secure.


⭐ Key Features
• Save WhatsApp status photos and videos
• One-tap status downloader — quick and easy
• Built-in image viewer & video player
• View saved statuses offline anytime
• Share or repost statuses easily
• No login required — safe & simple
• Lightweight, clean and user-friendly design


📌 How to Use
1️⃣ Open WhatsApp and view the status
2️⃣ Open WhatsApp Status Saver
3️⃣ Select the photo or video
4️⃣ Tap Download to save it instantly
Saved statuses remain in your gallery forever.


🔐 Privacy & Security
• No personal data collected
• No login required
• Your files are stored only on your device
• We respect user privacy
